issue.title: [Bug][202405]: SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_READ and WRITE not handled loganalyzer erros

failure.body:
### Issue Description

When running the drop_packets/drop_packets.py::test_drop_counters::test_ip_pkt_with_expired_ttl test we encounter the loganalyzer errors complaining that SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_WRITE(_READ) is not handled.

### Results you see

```
	 E               ERR gbsyncd#syncd: :- updateNotificationsPointers: pointer for SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_WRITE is not handled, FIXME!
	 E
	 E               ERR gbsyncd#syncd: :- updateNotificationsPointers: pointer for SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_READ is not handled, FIXME!
```

### Results you expected to see

We expect to ignore these errors, however the current regex expects the errors to stem from GBSAI and hence the ignore condition is not met.

The current regex:
`r, ".* ERR gbsyncd\d*#GBSAI.*pointer for SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_READ is not handled, FIXME.*"`

### Is it platform specific

generic

### Relevant log output

```shell
E               ERR gbsyncd#syncd: :- updateNotificationsPointers: pointer for SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_WRITE is not handled, FIXME!
	 E
	 E               ERR gbsyncd#syncd: :- updateNotificationsPointers: pointer for SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_READ is not handled, FIXME!
```

resolution.title: [Sonic-mgmt] Ignore SAI switch register read and write not handled logs
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

This PR relaxes the loganalyzer ignore rules to ignore all "SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_WRITE is not handled" and "SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_REGISTER_READ is not handled" errors.

Summary:
Fixes #15736

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

- [x] 202405

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
To help ignore loganalyzer error messages that lead to testcases failing in sonic-mgmt.

#### How did you do it?
Modify the loganalyzer regex to not check for GBSAI

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test to verify it ignores these errors.
